jobs.name: daily-hermes-agent-functional-merge-review
jobs.prompt:
Review the GitHub repository NousResearch/hermes-agent once per day and post a succinct summary of material functional changes/improvements merged in the last 24 hours.

Use live GitHub data (gh/git) and inspect enough detail to distinguish real functional changes from noise. Exclude docs-only changes, generated site output, deploy artifacts, pure metadata/version bumps, formatting-only churn, and CI-only changes unless they materially affect developer/release behavior.

Output requirements:
- Provide only the summary, with no surrounding explanation about methodology.
- Do NOT include PR numbers, commit hashes, links, or exhaustive change lists.
- Group related work into a short bullet list of material functional changes and improvements.
- Focus on user-facing behavior, runtime/tooling capabilities, reliability/security/data-integrity fixes, integrations/platform support, and developer workflow improvements.
- Keep it concise: aim for 3–8 bullets, one sentence each.
- If there were no material functional changes, output exactly: "No material functional changes merged in the last 24 hours."

jobs.name: Tinker weekly change-risk review
jobs.prompt:
Daily Tinker weekly change-review follow-up for Aaron. Work read-only.

Use America/Denver local date. Read `/Users/anichols/Obsidian/adn_vault/DailyGM/runs/<YYYY-MM-DD>/tinker_changes.json`, produced by the deterministic Good Morning runner. If it is absent, run `python3 /Users/anichols/Obsidian/.agents/scripts/gm/tinker_changes_phase.py --date <YYYY-MM-DD> --days 7` and parse its JSON; do not modify tracked files.

First use the deterministic collection as the source of truth for scope. If `commit_count` is 0 and `active_repo_count` is 0, reply exactly: `Tinker weekly review: no commits or local changes across 23 repos in the last 7 days; no review needed.`

Otherwise, inspect only `review_queue` items. For each, use the local Git repository and `gh` as needed to examine the actual commit/PR diff and surrounding code; do not infer behavior from a commit subject alone. Assess whether Aaron should review it as a support-services owner. Prioritize concrete concerns: authentication/authorization and Firebase rules; payment, payroll, booking, membership, inventory, or customer data impacts; destructive/migration behavior; production/deployment changes; cross-app integration; unusually large/complex or poorly tested changes; and clear opportunities for reliability or maintainability improvement.

Return a concise report with: (1) activity signal, (2) `Review now` items with repo + linked commit/PR + evidence-based reason, (3) `Watch / opportunity` items if warranted, and (4) a clear recommendation. If the deterministic collector found activity but no review-queue items, state that it was below the review threshold and name the affected repos. Do not make changes, open issues, or send messages outside this scheduled delivery.
